# Called while the goods are written onto the story
qpq_contract_goods_seal_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_down ?= yes }
		set_variable = qpq_offer_ct_tax_down
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_down ?= yes }
		set_variable = qpq_offer_ct_levy_down
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_revocation ?= yes }
		set_variable = qpq_offer_ct_revocation
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_council ?= yes }
		set_variable = qpq_offer_ct_council
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_war ?= yes }
		set_variable = qpq_offer_ct_war
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_fort ?= yes }
		set_variable = qpq_offer_ct_fort
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_coinage ?= yes }
		set_variable = qpq_offer_ct_coinage
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_faith ?= yes }
		set_variable = qpq_offer_ct_faith
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_tax_up ?= yes }
		set_variable = qpq_offer_ct_tax_up
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_ct_levy_up ?= yes }
		set_variable = qpq_offer_ct_levy_up
	}
}

# Root: the mirror story; prev: the main story
qpq_contract_goods_mirror_effect = {
	qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_offer_ct_tax_down }
	qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_offer_ct_levy_down }
	qpq_mirror_copy_var_effect = { VAR = qpq_offer_ct_revocation }

# On delivery: the contract itself changes, if they are still liege and vassal and the term can still move
qpq_contract_goods_deliver_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = qpq_offer_ct_tax_down
			scope:qpq_agent = { liege ?= scope:qpq_payer }
		}
		scope:qpq_agent = {
			if = {
				limit = { vassal_contract_obligation_level:feudal_government_taxes = 1 }
				vassal_contract_set_obligation_level = { type = feudal_government_taxes level = 0 }

			else_if = {
				limit = { vassal_contract_obligation_level:feudal_government_taxes = 2 }
